name: NEWS-G Collaboration
notes: The official site lists CERC, CFI, LSM, Queen's Physics and SNOLAB as partners, but CERC and CFI are Canadian funding programmes, not member institutions, so no institution_count is recorded from this.

summary.plain: The international team of physicists who built and run the NEWS-G spherical gas detectors, based at Queen's University in Canada.
summary.technical: Collaboration (led from Queen's University) operating the NEWS-G spherical-proportional-counter dark matter search, with detectors at LSM (Modane) and SNOLAB.
